connection_plan.missing_bridge: Instantiate G on the same profile and signature as the classical-God-root node: G v := some m.concrete satisfier of that signature's GOD_4 predicate exists at v. With reflexivity at w, the impossibility instance excludes an actual concrete GOD_4 satisfier at w, so it contradicts NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt for that signature. Record that instance as a typed rival of the node.
connection_plan.blocker: G has no case instance. The reverse possibility premise for that instance (an accessible world with no concrete GOD_4 satisfier) is stipulated, not argued, so the reverse modal argument is formal only until that premise has a positive account.
